title: Sample: Why a story sells better than a list of features
excerpt: Features describe your offer. A story shows a customer's life changing. The second one is easier to say yes to.
body:
This is a sample article. Replace it with your own writing from the dashboard.

## Start with the customer

A feature list answers the question "what is it?" A story answers a better one: "what happens to me if I say yes?"

## Keep one idea per piece

- One audience
- One problem
- One next step

> If you cannot say it plainly, the customer cannot either.

Write the plain version first. Then add the story.
